clue.text: Being tested, old train crashed on line

indicators.note: a train that has crashed is wrecked, so its letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: An old train is put through its paces and comes off the rails.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crashed' is the anagram signal; the definition is at the start, and 'on' is only a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone or something on trial is undergoing examination or a test run.

clue.text: A bit rusty, like a retired GP?

explanation.surface: A doctor who has stopped working is losing their touch.
explanation.definitionFit: Being rusty means lacking recent experience; a retired doctor no longer has a surgery, punning on practice as a medical business.

clue.text: Inn with a small restaurant

parts.note: an inn is a tavern, a place selling drink

explanation.surface: A pub with a little eatery attached.
explanation.definitionFit: A taverna is a modest Greek eating house, a kind of small restaurant.

clue.text: Girl after one's number

indicators.note: after places the girl's name behind the first piece

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I, and the 's adds an S
Sue is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl is chasing someone else's phone number.
explanation.definitionFit: An issue of a magazine is one numbered edition.

clue.text: Italian chap, in Spanish city, taking wrong road

parts.note: León is a city in northern Spain

indicators.note: the road taken is the wrong one, so its letters are put in a different order

explanation.surface: An Italian man visiting a Spanish city takes a wrong turning.
explanation.walkthrough: León is in Castile and León in northern Spain; 'wrong' signals the anagram, while 'in' and 'taking' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonardo is a typical Italian given name, as in Leonardo da Vinci.

clue.text: Leave course, disheartened

indicators.note: having its heart removed means the middle letter of the word goes

parts.note: a dessert is a course of a meal

explanation.surface: Someone abandons a golf or race course, feeling dispirited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' removes one middle S from DESSERT.
explanation.definitionFit: To desert is to abandon or quit a post or person.

clue.text: Child upset and tense at an order that must be obeyed

definitions.text: an order that must be obeyed

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the word for the child is read bottom to top

parts.note: a kid is a child
T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: An upset, tense child resents being given a command.
explanation.definitionFit: A diktat is a decree imposed by authority that allows no dissent.

clue.text: A game played by one Bond girl

explanation.surface: A card game enjoyed alone by a heroine from a spy film.
explanation.definitionFit: Patience-style card play for a single person shares its name with the tarot reader in the James Bond film Live and Let Die.

clue.text: Ignores redeveloped districts

indicators.note: an area redeveloped is rebuilt, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: Urban renewal neglects certain neighbourhoods.
explanation.definitionFit: Regions are areas or zones, like districts.

clue.text: tax flipping farm animals in a market town

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'tax flipping farm animals in a market town', starting lowercase: TAV (VAT reversed) + I + STOCK needs a word for I (likely 'One' lost at the start); no search found the full clue.
annotationWithheld.clue: tax flipping farm animals in a market town

clue.text: Delay approaching very large Nigerian port

parts.note: a lag is a delay
OS stands for outsize, a clothing size meaning very large

explanation.surface: A ship is held up as it nears a huge harbour in Nigeria.
explanation.walkthrough: 'approaching' is a link putting the pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Lagos is Nigeria's largest city and chief seaport.

clue.text: Gain an advantage over some charlatan abroad

indicators.note: abroad can mean widely scattered or astray, so the letters are spread into another order

explanation.surface: A con man overseas gets one over on his marks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abroad' looks like a place, but signals the rearrangement of all thirteen letters of 'some charlatan'.
explanation.definitionFit: To steal a march on someone is to get ahead of them by acting first, an idiom from military manoeuvres.

clue.text: Overlook, almost completely, a smithy

indicators.note: almost the whole word is used, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: to overlook something is to forget it

explanation.surface: Someone nearly misses a blacksmith's workshop.
explanation.definitionFit: A forge is a blacksmith's workshop with a furnace.

clue.text: In one action — easy to a skater

indicators.note: easy suggests free and loose, so the letters of the words are allowed to move into a new order

explanation.surface: A single smooth move is no trouble for a figure skater.
explanation.walkthrough: 'easy' is the rearrangement signal for 'to a skater'.
explanation.definitionFit: At a stroke means with one single effort or move.

clue.text: Piece of music playing in spa (hydro)

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters frolicking about and changing places

explanation.surface: A tune is heard at a health resort's hydro.
explanation.walkthrough: A hydro is a hotel or spa offering water treatments; 'in' joins the indicator to the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhapsody is an effusive, free-form musical composition.

clue.text: Allspice sprinkled over top of yoghurt for a particular purpose

indicators.note: in a down clue over means placed above the next piece
a spice sprinkled is scattered, so its letters are scattered into another order
the top of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Spice is scattered on a pot of yoghurt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sprinkled' turns ALLSPICE into SPECIALL, placed above the Y from 'top of yoghurt'.
explanation.definitionFit: Specially means expressly, for one specific end.

clue.text: Discover the absence of a Latin prayer book

parts.note: to miss something is to notice it is gone

explanation.surface: Someone notices that their Latin prayer book has gone.
explanation.definitionFit: A missal is a book containing the texts for Mass.

clue.text: Enterprising sort making torte with egg, whisked

indicators.note: whisked ingredients are beaten together, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: An ambitious baker makes a cake, beating in eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: A go-getter is an ambitious, energetic person.

clue.text: Cold fan in plant

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
a fan or devotee is a lover of something

explanation.surface: A chilly admirer is in a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: Clover is a low leafy plant of the pea family.

clue.text: Working daily? In theory

parts.note: a machine that is on is working
a daily is a newspaper published each day

explanation.surface: A question about someone with a daily job.
explanation.definitionFit: Something true on paper holds in principle but perhaps not in practice.

clue.text: Impetus created by Greek character returning after a short time

indicators.note: after places the reversed letter behind the short time

parts.note: a moment is a brief time

indicators.note: returning means the Greek letter is read backwards

parts.note: mu is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek person comes back after a brief spell and gains drive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns MU into UM; 'created by' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Momentum is the driving force gained by something in motion.

clue.text: One may be thrown by a child

definitions.text: One may be thrown by a child

parts.words: One may be thrown by a child
parts.note: reads like a ball or toy being thrown, but means a fit of temper that a child is said to throw

explanation.definitionFit: Children are said to throw a fit of rage, an outburst of bad temper.

clue.text: Comic strip character's servant

explanation.surface: A cartoon hero is somebody's servant.
explanation.definitionFit: The caped crusader of DC Comics shares his name with an army officer's personal servant.

clue.text: At home, soldier, with no one else present

parts.note: to be in is to be at home
a private is a soldier of the lowest rank

explanation.surface: A soldier spends time alone at home.
explanation.definitionFit: In private means away from others, without witnesses.

clue.text: Person beyond saving, individual imprisoned by King George

indicators.note: imprisoned by means held inside the letters for the king

parts.note: GR stands for Georgius Rex, King George
an individual is one

explanation.surface: A doomed prisoner of King George.
explanation.definitionFit: A goner is someone dead or done for, past rescue.

clue.text: Composer, gross I say

parts.note: eg (for example) means say

explanation.surface: A remark that a composer's work is disgusting.
explanation.definitionFit: Edvard Grieg was a Norwegian composer, of Peer Gynt fame.

clue.text: Slippery customer pinching 10p in bar

indicators.note: pinching means holding the coins tightly within the eel

parts.note: an eel is the proverbial slippery creature
ten is the Roman numeral X, and p stands for penny

explanation.surface: A shifty character steals ten pence in a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link; 'bar' is the verb, to ban or shut out.
explanation.definitionFit: To expel is to throw out and ban someone.

clue.text: Dominating woman disturbed Rita during parade

indicators.note: during means placed within the parade

parts.note: a march is a parade

indicators.note: disturbed means the letters of the name are upset and rearranged

explanation.surface: Rita is upset as a parade passes, like a formidable matron.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' signals an anagram of the name, and 'during' places it inside the parade.
explanation.definitionFit: A matriarch is a woman who heads and rules a family.

clue.text: See fabric in drawer

parts.note: the word see sounds like the letter C
rayon is a synthetic fabric

explanation.surface: An instruction to look at material kept in a chest of drawers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawer' is not furniture but one who draws.
explanation.definitionFit: A crayon is a stick of colour used for drawing pictures.

clue.text: Programme to improve health of most of army unit

indicators.note: most of means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a regiment is a unit of an army

explanation.surface: Fitness training for much of a regiment.
explanation.definitionFit: A regimen is a prescribed course of diet or exercise.
